## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**8. Energy Trend?**

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Neutral tactical posture: favor selective exposure to energy XLE (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +10.14%) ABOVE TREND and EM EEM (1W: +2.32% | 1M: +5.66%) ABOVE TREND, reduce exposure to weak industrial/cyclical ETFs like XLI (1W: -1.06% | 1M: -5.14%) BELOW TREND and monitor credit (HYG/LQD).

**12. Commodities to Watch?**

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~20 (current 17.72) marks complacency if broken lower; HYG/LQD ~0.75 (current 0.7505) signals credit health; SPY/TLT (current 9.37) for stocks vs bonds regime shifts; Tech vs Financials ratio (3.2234) to watch for leadership rotations.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive, VXX (1W: -3.49% | 1M: -12.41%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND but HYG/LQD shows credit stress ↑, producing mixed signals. Energy (XLE (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +10.14%) ABOVE TREND) and EM (EEM (1W: +2.32% | 1M: +5.66%) ABOVE TREND) showing strength while industrials (XLI (1W: -1.06% | 1M: -5.14%) BELOW TREND) and weak breadth are key divergences to monitor.
